turns.q: Do I have to pay anything to return the damaged item?
turns.replyTail:
:
Yes—there may be costs, depending on the process. For normal returns, you pay tracked or registered return shipping; it is refunded only if Wild Earth made an error. For damaged or faulty items, use the warranty process with proof of purchase. You may need to pay shipping to Wild Earth or the supplier for assessment, and return shipping if the claim is declined. Warranty returns must be clean and dry and are separate from standard returns.
